sentences.en: But we end up leading a march of over a thousand people through the city of Tallahassee.

sentences.en: All those other ones, you can add a little bit onto the story where it's not clear cut.

sentences.en: You can't clear cut this one.

sentences.zh: 这次你没法模糊处理。

sentences.en: Going through neighborhoods, it was such a unique demonstration of unity.

sentences.en: We had people coming outside, joining the march.
sentences.zh: 人们纷纷走出家门，加入游行队伍。

sentences.en: The other day, we did over 12 miles.

sentences.en: I said, we are going.

sentences.en: I am pumped up.
sentences.zh: 我斗志昂扬。

sentences.en: I am

sentences.en: And until today, I didn't even know.

sentences.en: I thought rubber bullets were like little BB gun things.
sentences.zh: 我原以为橡胶子弹就像BB弹枪里的小东西。

sentences.en: They're huge.

sentences.en: They're ginormous.

sentences.en: So like a BB gun, they're just little balls.
sentences.zh: 就像BB弹一样，只是小球而已。

sentences.en: But these things, it looks like, it's like the shape of like a bullet, but it's rubber on most of it.
sentences.zh: 但这些东西，看起来，形状像子弹，但大部分是橡胶做的。

sentences.en: And then on the end, it's plastic.

sentences.en: I don't know what to compare it to.

sentences.en: It was like maybe like half of a phone.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: It was like half the face.

sentences.en: I can't do anything but be black.
sentences.zh: 我除了做个黑人，别无选择。

sentences.en: I can't wash it off.
sentences.zh: 我无法洗掉肤色。

sentences.en: I can't take it away.
sentences.zh: 我无法摆脱它。

sentences.en: So me walking out of the house and walking into work, if you feel threatened by that existence, that is not my problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我走出家门去上班，而你因为我的存在感到威胁，那不是我的问题。

sentences.en: That is not my place to try to change you and try to kind of morph you into the person that I want to be.
sentences.zh: 我没有义务去改变你，或者试图把你塑造成我想要的样子。

sentences.en: You kind of have to do that for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你得自己去完成那种改变。

sentences.en: And if you're willing to do that for yourself, then I applaud you.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意为自己做出改变，那我为你鼓掌。

sentences.en: And if you're not, will I help you get to a place where you can?
sentences.zh: 如果你不愿意，我能帮你达到那个境界吗？

sentences.en: What's giving me hope?
sentences.zh: 是什么给了我希望？

sentences.en: These people keep protesting.

sentences.en: I love it.

sentences.en: Listen, I got other stuff I could be watching.

sentences.en: I come home every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天下班回家。

sentences.en: I've been watching this stuff morning, noon and night.
sentences.zh: 我从早到晚都在看这些内容。

sentences.en: On the weekend, I watch it.
sentences.zh: 周末我也看。

sentences.en: I come home from work.
sentences.zh: 我下班回家。

sentences.en: I'm watching it right now while I'm talking to you.
sentences.zh: 我现在跟你说话的时候也在看。

sentences.en: My TV's on here.

sentences.en: I got to be watching something else.
sentences.zh: 我本该看点别的。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 但我没有。

sentences.en: What's important is I love seeing all these people come together and they protest them.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我喜欢看到所有人团结起来进行抗议。

sentences.en: Now, am I proud of the people when they looting?
sentences.zh: 那么，当人们抢劫时，我感到自豪吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.zh: 我在乎吗？

sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: That's part of the proteSt. You're not going to get people's attention if you do friendly protests.
sentences.zh: 那是抗议的一部分。如果你只搞温和的抗议，是不会引起人们注意的。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, when you're getting people's attention, when you start destroying stuff.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，当你开始破坏东西时，人们才会注意到你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Oh, now they're destroying stuff.
sentences.zh: 哦，现在他们开始破坏东西了。

sentences.en: Now they got our attention.
sentences.zh: 现在他们引起我们的注意了。

sentences.en: Now, how do we stop them from destroying stuff?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该如何阻止他们破坏东西呢？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: We got to hear what they talking about.
sentences.zh: 我们得听听他们在说什么。

sentences.en: This feels different because there are people out there demonstrating that we've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 这次感觉不同，因为走上街头示威的人群是我们从未见过的。

sentences.en: They haven't been in marches and protests before.
sentences.zh: 他们以前从未参加过游行和抗议。

sentences.en: I do think this was a watershed moment that caused things to be different.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这是一个分水岭，让一切变得不同了。

sentences.en: When I'm protesting, I am out also protesting, you know, for my father's death at the hands of law enforcement to make sure that our future is much brighter
sentences.zh: 我参加抗议，也是为了我父亲死于执法者之手而抗议，为了确保我们的未来更加光明

sentences.en: we don't have to be fearful of traffic stops.
sentences.zh: 我们不必再对交通拦截感到恐惧。

sentences.en: You know, we don't have to be fearful because we see a cop.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不必因为看到警察就感到害怕。

sentences.en: That's what I'm marching for so that other young men in this world can see their father.
sentences.zh: 这就是我游行的目的，为了让世界上其他年轻人能见到他们的父亲。

sentences.en: And it's so unfortunate for the daughter of, of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德的女儿遭遇了这一切，真是太不幸了。

sentences.en: She's sort of in my shoes, you know, you grow up through life and, you know, who's going to take her to the, the, the father and daughter lunch and the father daughter dance.
sentences.zh: 她有点像当年的我，你知道，你在成长过程中，谁会带她去参加父女午餐会和父女舞会呢？

sentences.en: And it was same with me because my dad actually used to come to the parent lunchings.
sentences.zh: 我当时也是一样，因为我爸爸以前常来参加家长午餐会。

sentences.en: You know, when I had lunch, I would pop up and I would see him and he would surprise me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我吃午饭时，他会突然出现，给我一个惊喜。

sentences.en: You wouldn't think nothing of it.
sentences.zh: 你根本不会多想。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know if my parents is going to come, but it's lunchtime and, and, you know, he's out, out at the table before you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道父母会不会来，但到了午餐时间，他已经坐在桌子前等着你了。

sentences.en: I mean, it was such a
sentences.zh: 我是说，那真是一段

sentences.en: great experience, you know, that I just want people to understand that it's, it's evident that
sentences.zh: 很棒的经历，你知道，我只是想让人们明白，显而易见的是

sentences.en: hate killed Mr. Floyd, hate killed him.
sentences.zh: 仇恨杀死了弗洛伊德先生，是仇恨杀了他。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.zh: 他才46岁。

sentences.en: Well, I'm 44.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我44岁。

sentences.en: I've been harassed by the police several times.
sentences.zh: 我曾多次受到警察的骚扰。

sentences.en: I'm a black male in America.
sentences.zh: 我是美国的黑人男性。

sentences.en: And it's one of these things that I can, I can relate to what happened to this man's family.
sentences.zh: 这让我感同身受，我能理解这个男人的家人所经历的一切。

sentences.en: Got two boys.
sentences.zh: 我有两个儿子。

sentences.en: My youngest son, he's 13.
sentences.zh: 小儿子13岁。

sentences.en: My oldest son, he's 24.
sentences.zh: 大儿子24岁。

sentences.en: Now the conversation I have with my kids is about this.
sentences.zh: 现在我和孩子们谈论的就是这件事。

sentences.en: You always got to be careful when you interact with white folks.
sentences.zh: 你和白人打交道时一定要小心。

sentences.en: Why do I got to keep having this conversation?
sentences.zh: 为什么我非得一直进行这种谈话？

sentences.en: Do I wish I didn't have to have that conversation?
sentences.zh: 我希望自己不必进行这种谈话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, but that's not the world we live in.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我们生活的世界并非如此。

sentences.en: So that's why I keep having this conversation with my kids because I don't want nothing to happen to them.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直和孩子们谈论这个，因为我不希望他们出事。

sentences.en: I think that it is about to get justice for George Floyd and to try to make one thing in the world fair.
sentences.zh: 我认为这关乎为乔治·弗洛伊德伸张正义，并试图让世界变得公平一点。

sentences.en: Like people have been trying for years and I don't think it's gotten any better.
sentences.zh: 就像人们多年来一直尝试的那样，但我认为情况并没有好转。

sentences.en: So I feel like right now we're trying to draw a line to all of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉现在我们正试图为这一切划清界限。

sentences.en: I'm going back out there tomorrow because it's not about me no more.
sentences.zh: 我明天还要去，因为这不再仅仅关乎我个人了。

sentences.en: That's why I want people to know it's not about me no more.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我想让人们知道，这不再仅仅关乎我个人。

sentences.en: My son, he's going to, he's 13.
sentences.zh: 我儿子，他才13岁。

sentences.en: He's going to be an adult one day.
sentences.zh: 他总有一天会成为成年人。

sentences.en: Do we got to live like this his whole life?
sentences.zh: 难道我们要让他一辈子都这样生活吗？

sentences.en: No, he shouldn't have to.
sentences.zh: 不，他不应该这样。

sentences.en: Will he have kids?

sentences.en: Will his kids have to live like this their whole lives?
sentences.zh: 他的孩子也要一辈子这样生活吗？

sentences.en: No, they shouldn't have to.
sentences.zh: 不，他们不应该这样。

sentences.en: So we got to go out here and march every day or go downtown and sit in front of the city hall till they change these walls on the books.

sentences.en: Hey, I'm with it.

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Thursday, George Floyd was honored at a memorial service in Minneapolis that was attended by hundreds of grieving friends, family, lawmakers, and community members.
sentences.zh: 周四，乔治·弗洛伊德在明尼阿波利斯市的追悼会上受到缅怀，数百名悲痛的亲友、家人、立法者和社区成员出席了仪式。

sentences.en: I want us to not sit here and act like we had a funeral on the schedule.
sentences.zh: 我不希望我们坐在这里，表现得好像我们原本就安排了一场葬礼一样。

sentences.en: George Floyd should not be among the deceased.
sentences.zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德本不该成为逝者。

sentences.en: He did not die of common health conditions.
sentences.zh: 他并非死于常见的健康问题。

sentences.en: He died of a common American criminal justice malfunction.
sentences.zh: 他死于美国刑事司法系统常见的功能失调。

sentences.en: Speakers, including Reverend Al Sharpton, said that Floyd's death at the hands of Minneapolis police officers would not be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 包括阿尔·夏普顿牧师在内的演讲者表示，弗洛伊德死于明尼阿波利斯警官之手，这一事实不会被遗忘。

sentences.en: It was just amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太令人惊叹了。

sentences.en: Everywhere you go and see people, how they cling to him.
sentences.zh: 无论你走到哪里，看到人们，他们是多么依恋他。

sentences.en: They wanted to be around him.
sentences.zh: 他们都想待在他身边。

sentences.en: You know, George, he was like a general.
sentences.zh: 你知道，乔治，他就像一位将军。

sentences.en: Every day he walks outside, there'd be a line of people wanting to greet him and wanted to have fun with him.
sentences.zh: 他每天走出门，都会有一排人等着向他问候，想和他一起开心。

sentences.en: During the service, Floyd's brother, Philonis, remembered sharing banana and mayonnaise sandwiches with him as a child and described him as a cherished figure in the community.
sentences.zh: 在追悼会上，弗洛伊德的兄弟菲洛尼斯回忆起儿时与他分享香蕉蛋黄酱三明治的情景，并称他是社区里备受珍视的人物。

sentences.en: When you spoke to George, they felt like they were the president because that's how he made you feel.
sentences.zh: 当你和乔治交谈时，他们会觉得自己就像总统一样，因为他就是能让你有这种感觉。

sentences.en: Everybody wants justice.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想要正义。

sentences.en: We want justice for George.
sentences.zh: 我们想要为乔治讨回公道。

sentences.en: He's going to get it.
sentences.zh: 他会得到的。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
